document.about: IRS Form W-9 (Rev. March 2024). Its instructions set `General Instructions` and `Specific Instructions` in 14pt bold, their sections in 12pt bold, and each line's instructions under `Line 1`, `Line 2`… in 10pt bold.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#393): `Line 1` was h5 under `Specific Instructions` at h1, two levels skipped: the form's own bold labels on page 1 held h3 and h4.

checks.issue: #393: `Line 1` was h5 directly under an h1.
